items.q: What should you remember about **No time to practice is a sound problem**?
items.a: **anchor reps to messaging,** driving, reading, doorways, calls, meetings, introductions, Q&A, and goodbyes.

items.q: What should you remember about **Voice notes > texts for skill**?
items.a: **typing gives unlimited edit time; voice forces real-time clarity** — the same skill meetings and stage require.

items.q: What should you remember about **Multi-take voice notes are training**?
items.a: **Vinh re-recorded 5× at** first; awareness of rambling/circles led to one-take sends.

items.q: What should you remember about **Voice notes add speed + tone**?
items.a: **brain at 100 mph;** typing slows; voice carries sincerity, energy, intent; prevents misread texts.

items.q: What should you remember about **LinkedIn voice-note hack**?
items.a: **~90% reply rate; novelty** + human warmth vs cold text outreach.

items.q: What should you remember about **Singers warm up; speakers don't**?
items.a: **5 min in the car**: E-O (articulation), lip flutters (cords/mask), siren (range + break smoothing).

items.q: What should you remember about **Read aloud = active training**?
items.a: **mind-mouth connection; play volume/pitch/rate** like slider bars; breaking-news email vs bedtime-story book.

items.q: What should you remember about **Doorframe = stage entrance**?
items.a: **shoulders down/back, head tall;** dozens of daily reps at home/work/café until default.

items.q: What should you remember about **Stand on calls**?
items.a: **chest open, diaphragm free →** stronger voice; posture affects cognition; gestures move voice; smile = audible warmth.

items.q: What should you remember about **Hands above table**?
items.a: **universal "no weapons" trust** signal; enables gestures; hiding hands reads secretive/nervous.
**remember names + make** people feel valued; "sweetest sound" lights up their brain.

items.q: What should you remember about **3-second pause before answers**?
items.a: **organize thoughts, avoid ramble, build anticipation, signal authority** — speed ≠ intelligence.
